summary_md: **XiaoAnLab ([@xiaoanlab](https://x.com/xiaoanlab/status/2116378014179340329))** describes Microsoft's **skill-recorder**. You record a repetitive desktop task once and it becomes a SKILL.md or a scheduled automation an agent can follow ([microsoft/skill-recorder](https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - microsoft/skill-recorder: Desktop app that records your on-screen work session and uses the GitHub Copilot SDK to reconstruct it as an intent + ordered steps, then builds a reusable Skill or Automation for Microsoft Autopilots like Scout, Microsoft Copilot Cowork, or Copilot Studio.
